fields.name: Kanakapriyā Devī (daughter of Vyāsācārya)
fields.notes:
The daughter of Śrī Vyāsācārya of Viṣṇupura and the sister of Kṛṣṇavallabha Ācārya. Gatigovinda, the son of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya, was her spiritual master (Karṇānanda 2).

The record also held Kanakapriyā Devī the wife of King Candrāya, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
She and her husband, King Candrāya, were disciples of Narottama Ṭhākura (Prema-vilāsa 20; see «Candrāya»). Taken out of the record «Kanakapriya Devī» #668, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Keśava (nephew of Rāmacandra Gosvāmī)
fields.notes:
The nephew of Rāmacandra Gosvāmī of Bāghnāpāḍā. He composed a padāvalī titled Keśava-saṅgīta (History of Brajabuli Literature p. 427).

The record also held the Keśava disciple of Rasikānanda, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
He was a disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.119). Taken out of the record «Keśava» #720, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Kiśora (disciple of Śyāmānanda)
fields.notes:
He was a disciple of Śyāmānanda Prabhu and lived at Kasiāḍi in the district of Midnapore.

The record also held the Kiśora disciple of Rasikānanda, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
He was a disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.161). Taken out of the record «Kiśora» #729, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

He was a disciple of Rāmacandra Kavirāja (Karṇānanda 2).

The record also held the Kṛṣṇa Ācārya of Gopālpur, disciple of Narottama Ṭhākura, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).

A Vārendra brāhmaṇa and a disciple of Narottama Ṭhākura; his Śrīpāṭa was at Gopālpur (Prema-vilāsa 20, Narottama-vilāsa 12). Taken out of the record «Kṛṣṇa Ācārya» #735, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Kṛṣṇagati (son of Rasikānanda)
fields.notes:
The second son and a disciple of Rasikānanda Prabhu (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.27). He went to Śyāmasundarapur, where he served Śrī Rādhā-Vṛndāvanacandra; he is also called a disciple (?) of Kiśoradeva, one of the mahāntas of the first twelve branches of Śyāmānanda Prabhu. An erudite scholar and an accomplished singer; his descendants still live at Śyāmasundarapur.

The record also held Kṛṣṇagati the son of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
The son born of the youngest wife of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya Prabhu. Taken out of the record «Krsnagati» #777, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Madanamohana Ṭhākura (grandson of Raghunandana)
fields.notes:
A vaidya; his father was Kānāi Ṭhākura, his grandfather the famous Raghunandana Ṭhākura and his great-grandfather Śrī Mukunda. He had one brother, Vaṁśī (Bhakti-ratnākara 13.189-194). He was a disciple of Śyāmānanda (Rasikamaṅgala Dakṣiṇa 10.3).

The record also held the Madanamohana Ṭhākura of Śrīnivāsa's family, of Mālihāṭī, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).

He belonged to the family of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya. His Śrīpāṭa was at Mālihāṭī, where his descendants still live. Taken out of the record «Madanamohana Ṭhākura» #855, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Madhusūdana (disciple of Śyāmānanda)
fields.notes:
He was a disciple of Śrī Śyāmānanda (Prema-vilāsa 20).

The record also held the Madhusūdana of Lord Caitanya's branch and the poet Madhusūdana, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
He belonged to Lord Caitanya's branch; his name is in the list of the branches (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.111). Taken out of the record «Madhusūdana» #883, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
A composer of padas; the Padakalpataru has five of his padas. Taken out of the record «Madhusūdana» #883, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Mahāmāyā (wife of Govinda Kavirāja)
fields.notes:
She was a disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya, the wife of Śrī Govinda Kavirāja and the mother of King Divyasiṁha (see «Govinda Kavirāja»).

The record also held Mahāmāyā the wife of Uddhāraṇa Datta, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
She was the wife of Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura. Taken out of the record «Mahāmāyā» #888, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Mathurā Dāsa (disciple of Śrīnivāsa)
fields.notes:
He was a disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya (Karṇānanda 1).

The record also held three other Mathurā Dāsas: the brāhmaṇa of Mathurā, the poet, and the disciple of Narottama Ṭhākura, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
A brāhmaṇa who lived in Mathurā. Taken out of the record «Mathurā Dāsa» #914, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
A composer of padas (pada no. 789 in the Padakalpataru). Taken out of the record «Mathurā Dāsa» #914, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
He was a disciple of Narottama Ṭhākura (Prema-vilāsa 20, Narottama-vilāsa 12). Taken out of the record «Mathurā Dāsa» #914, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Mohana Dāsa (disciple of Śrīnivāsa)
fields.notes:
A vaidya, a composer of padas and a friend of Śrī Govinda Kavirāja, a disciple of Ācārya Prabhu (Śrīnivāsa); he did bhajana in Vṛndāvana with Vrajānanda dāsa, Hariprasāda dāsa, Sukhānanda dāsa and Premī Harirāma dāsa (Karṇānanda 1). Thirty-five padas of «Mohana Dāsa» are in the Padakalpataru. The record calls him also Mukuṭarāma dāsa.

The record also held three Mohanas disciples of Rasikānanda (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.104, 14.148, 14.153), now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
He was a disciple of Rasikānanda (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.104). Taken out of the record «Mohana» #925, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
He was a disciple of Rasikānanda (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.148). Taken out of the record «Mohana» #925, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
He was a disciple of Rasikānanda (Rasikamaṅgala Paścima 14.153). Taken out of the record «Mohana» #925, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

He was a disciple of Narottama Ṭhākura (Prema-vilāsa 20, Narottama-vilāsa 12).

The record also held the Murāri Dāsa of the Bhaktamālā, whose foot-water Rasika Murāri drank, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).

Born in a low-caste family, he was a great bhāgavata: when Rasika Murāri visited his house he drank the water that had washed Murāri's feet (Bhaktamālā 23.3). Taken out of the record «Murāri Dāsa» #949, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Nandakiśora Dāsa (disciple of Abhirāma)
fields.notes:
According to the Pāṭa-paryaṭana he was a disciple of Śrī Abhirāma Gosvāmī, and his Śrīpāṭa was at Cunākhālī.

The record also held the Nandakiśora Dāsa of Nityānanda's branch, author of the Vṛndāvana-līlāmṛta, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).

He belonged to the branch of Nityānanda Prabhu; his Śrīpāṭa was at Puruniā. By the order of the Bādshāh he installed the Deities of Śrī Śrī Nitāi-Gaura at Śṛṅgāravaṭa in Vṛndāvana. Commanded by Lord Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma he wrote the Śrī Vṛndāvana-līlāmṛta and the Śrī Rasa-kalikā. Taken out of the record «Nandakisor Dāsa» #968, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Nārāyaṇa (brother of Dāmodara Paṇḍita)
fields.notes:
He was the brother of Dāmodara Paṇḍita (Vaiṣṇava-vandanā; see «Jagannātha»).

The record also held the Nārāyaṇa of Nityānanda's branch, brother of Devānanda, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).

He belonged to the branch of Nityānanda Prabhu and was the brother of Devānanda; a brāhmaṇa from Navadvīpa (the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna: a vaidya) (Caitanya-bhāgavata 2.8.209; Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 11.75, Ādi 11.46). Taken out of the record «Nārāyaṇa» #1005, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

fields.name: Nayana Bhāskara (disciple of Śyāmānanda)
fields.notes:
He was a disciple of Śrī Śyāmānanda Prabhu (Prema-vilāsa 20).

The record also held the sculptor Nayana Bhāskara of Hālisahara, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).

A sculptor from Hālisahara. Śrīmatī Jāhnavā Devī ordered him to carve a Deity of Śrī Rādhā for Śrī Śrī Gopīnātha in Vṛndāvana (Bhakti-ratnākara 10.321, 11.244-245, 11.788). Taken out of the record «Nayana Bhaskara» #1024, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
